'''Kerkoidens''' were a rough-skinned alien species with clawed hands and elongated snouts, from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kerkoidia/Legends|Kerkoidia]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:DookuLoathsom-TCWCG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Dooku confers with General Loathsom]]
Descended from the quadruped predators of the savannas and jungles of [[Kerkoidia/Legends|Kerkoidia]], Kerkoidens had long snouts, long claws, and jutting teeth. They were aggressive, but also very cunning beings. The species as a whole had fought its animal instinct to prove to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that they were civilized and sophisticated.<ref name="TCWCG" />

==Kerkoidens in the galaxy==
Many Kerkoidens served as [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One notable Kerkoiden was the Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]], who led the [[Retail Caucus/Legends|Retail Clan's]] [[LR-57 combat droid/Legends|droid]] forces at the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Kerkoiden were based on the initial designs for the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] species by concept artist [[Doug Chiang]].<ref name="Neimoidian Inspiration">{{SW|url=news/back-from-the-drawing-board-recycled-star-wars-aliens|text=Back from the Drawing Board: Recycled ''Star Wars'' Aliens|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>
